set.reason: The criterion expressly permits rectangle partitions as an alternative to triangle partitions. Retain each route conditionally rather than conjoin the area formulas for every figure. set.reason: The criterion explicitly permits triangles OR rectangles. Preserve triangle area as a component of the triangular-piece route without making every composite-area task use it.
set.scope: Calculating triangular pieces in a triangular partition of a composite area
